line.label: Number
line.failed: the next number could not be read; the document still takes it when it is saved.
line.preview: {number} — the next of its series, given when it is saved (not reserved).
line.newPeriod: {number} — the first of {year}, given when it is saved (not reserved).
line.typed: {number} — the number it had in the old system ({reason}).
line.typeOne: Type a number for a migrated document…

held.noSeries: no number series for this kind of document yet: an admin sets it up in Admin › Documents & numbering.
held.several: this company keeps several series of this kind: the number comes from the one the document names.
held.closed: its number series is closed: an admin opens a new one in Admin › Documents & numbering.
held.exhausted: its number series has given its last number: an admin opens a new one in Admin › Documents & numbering.

override.title: Type a number for a migrated document
override.body: A document carried over from the old system keeps the number it had there instead of the next number of its series. Invoices, credit notes and DDTs never do: their series never skips or reuses a number.
override.numberHint: Letters, digits and / . _ - , up to 40, no spaces.
override.reasonHint: For example: an open order carried over from the old system. It is kept in the record's history.
override.ok: No document has this number, and the series will not give it.
override.failed: The number could not be checked: type it again, or try later.

refusal.kind: This kind of document always takes the next number of its series.
refusal.shape: Type the number as it was printed: letters, digits and / . _ - , up to 40, no spaces.
refusal.reason: Say why this document keeps its old number.
refusal.taken: This number is used already: another document of this kind has it.
refusal.future: The series will give this number later: type another, or move the series past it first (Admin › Documents & numbering).

held.checking: Wait for the check of the number.
held.failed: The number could not be checked yet.
held.reason: Say why it keeps this number.
